000-clean-non-ascii.bin.note: control: signed U+FFFD as a valid three-byte sequence; must verify

001-invalid-continuation-byte.bin.note: the reported case: EF BF BD replaced by lone 0x80; a replacing decoder maps it back onto the signed payload

002-utf8-bom.bin.note: BOM before the document; a decoder that strips it accepts, one that keeps it rejects

004-overlong-encoding.bin.note: overlong form of U+002F, forbidden by RFC 3629

005-surrogate-in-utf8.bin.note: UTF-16 surrogate D800 encoded in UTF-8, forbidden

006-invalid-byte-in-ascii-value.bin.note: invalid byte where the signed value was ASCII; both must say malformed, not one invalid and one malformed
